@name: Chancellor
@slug: chancellor
@source: channeling_companion
@category: RMFRP Channeling Companion
@default_cost: 57
@description:
 [Vocational] A Chancellor handles the administrative affairs of a religion.
 He is also a spiritual leader of a congregation of believers. The
 Chancellor's job is to provide support and inspiration to the followers of
 his religion. He also handles and presides over many of the religion's
 ceremonies. Leaving the actual teaching to ministers, a Chancellor handles
 the major decisions that a religion has to face. Quote: Gather the assembly,
 there are important matters I must discuss with them. Time to Acquire: 64
 months. Starting Money: normal. Professional Qualifier: At least 12 ranks in
 Religion [-4 points]
